payload.title: Headless published-content delivery for application consumers
payload.description:
Design-only planning requested by Ryan during voice. Implementation remains unstarted; no code, infrastructure, deployment, purchase or publishing authorization is implied. Initial status stays open (Discovery), unassigned.

As an application developer, I want a minimal versioned JSON delivery contract for published Papyrus content, so that applications can consume articles without depending on a page renderer or internal CMS schema.

Definition of Done for later implementation: documented v1 contract, individual article retrieval, list/filter/pagination and public asset references, common visibility/update handling and isolation specifications. Structured fields plus a Markus body string are required; renderer-specific HTML or body IR is not a required interchange contract. Depends on the shared foundation; examine existing Published* and Markus/S3 projection before choosing static JSON versus request-time transport. Reuse M8 PPY-f293ea where appropriate; its latest/search JSON lacks the full article contract. No new publishing engine.

Deferred/YAGNI: Markdown+YAML export, exact Contentful API compatibility, extra export formats and authenticated draft previews. This is delivery for public application consumers, not an editorial API or a new authoring backend.
